# World coverage

**Derived view, generated by `atlas/tools/world_coverage.py`. Don't edit by hand.** It shows which parts of the setting the [Sunday Morning stories](../../wiki/Sunday-Morning/README.md) use, so a new season can reach for what the world has and no story has touched yet ([The Long Road](../../wiki/Sunday-Morning/Notes/The-Long-Road.md#using-the-world)). A thing counts as used when a story is connected to it on the [Atlas](../README.md), or when the story's plan or draft links to its wiki section. A story can use something without linking it (Season 1's language habits and many of its dishes are like that), so this undercounts a little. A parked [story seed](../../wiki/Sunday-Morning/Stories/Story-Seeds.md) doesn't count as use; an unused thing a seed reaches for is marked *seeded*.

Being used isn't a target. A story uses what it needs, and some things (a map outline, an open question) shouldn't be used at all. Left out on purpose: **Foundations** (world rules: constraints every story follows, not material to use); **Questions** (open questions: deliberately not settled by any story).
